environment.description: Container running on EKS with default pod security context. Filesystem is writable (default emptyDir mounts). Network policy allows direct client connections to the pod on port 8080 with sub-millisecond latency from within the same VPC. No rate limiting or jitter injection. Pod runs with NET_RAW capability allowing precise network timing measurements from adjacent pods.

config.network: direct pod-to-pod, no service mesh, Calico CNI with no network policies applied
config.resources: dedicated node, no CPU throttling, guaranteed QoS class
